entities.name: Mandrake Nightshade
entities.description: An evil black and red mage who destroyed Martuk and fell in his final battle on Mt. Margalus.

entities.name: Great Magus War
entities.description: War during which Mandrake destroyed Martuk.

entities.name: Mt. Margalus
entities.description: Site of Mandrake's final battle, now Mandrake's Mountain and cursed.

entities.name: Selena Mistencharmer
entities.description: Defeated Mandrake with Slides Stardust and cursed the mountain.

entities.name: Slides Stardust
entities.description: Defeated Mandrake with Selena Mistencharmer and cursed the mountain.

events.summary: Mandrake Nightshade destroys Martuk during the Great Magus War.
Mandrake summons dragons and pit lords but falls at the hands of Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust.
events.quote: he summoned several dragons and pit lords, only to fall at the hands of Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust

events.summary: Fearing his resurrection, Selena and Slides put a draining curse on the mountain.
events.quote: they put a dangerous curse on the mountain that would drain anyone who set foot on the mountain

relations.note: Fell at her hands with Slides Stardust.
relations.quote: fall at the hands of Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust
